MicMyDay 0.9.3

The first public release.

  • Hold your shortcut, speak, and the words land in whatever app you were already in.
  • Transcription runs on your Mac with Whisper, Parakeet or Nemotron, or through OpenAI or Gemini if you prefer.
  • Rewrite profiles turn what you said into a tidied note, a message, or an instruction for a coding agent.
  • A recording with no voice in it is dropped rather than guessed at.
